baseline_models.focus_anchor: The placement construction at word 2, being upon a sharia at word 4, its source in the affair at word 6, and the paired following commands at words 7 and 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: The addressee is installed on an exposed, directed access course issuing from the affair. Following is therefore movement along an available line, while desires exert a rival pull away from it.

activation_trace.role: Transformation into a state makes the divine act an installation into a position rather than mere production.
An exposed entry to water supplies the course with material accessibility and a sustaining destination.
A directed extension or opening gives the accessible course an aimed orientation.
Affair as a state or concern makes the course arise from an encompassing order of things.
Going behind, obeying, and taking an exemplar supplies the actual locomotion along the course.
The soul's inclination supplies the competing attraction that can draw movement off-course.

changed_reading.before: The addressee is given a law and told to obey it rather than other people's desires.
changed_reading.after: The addressee is installed at a reachable, life-oriented course sourced in the affair and must travel its line instead of yielding to rival pulls.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exact repetition of the following root in the imperative and prohibition, the plural desires, and the closing denial of knowledge.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse presents two kinetic trajectories rather than a static contrast of rules and feelings. One trajectory is directed and continuously traceable; the other accelerates, drops, and lacks reliable waymarks.

activation_trace.role: Directed projection supplies a stable heading for the positive trajectory.
Following behind makes both the command and prohibition choices of whom or what will lead.
Unbroken succession turns following into a continuing trajectory rather than a single assent.
Falling toward a depth gives the rival trajectory a downward consequence.
Rapid rushing supplies the rival trajectory's impulsive speed and weakens deliberative control.
A distinguishing waymark makes knowledge operational orientation rather than stored information.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts obedience with subjective preference.
changed_reading.after: The verse requires a continuing choice of trajectory: track the marked heading, or be swept into a fast but unmarked descent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Being placed upon a course from the affair, followed by a command not to follow the plural desires of an unknowing group.
baseline_models.mechanism: The placement can be read as delegated public judgment. The affair supplies authority and deliberation, the course supplies an undertaking, and the prohibited desires become factional opinions that would capture that judgment.

activation_trace.role: Installation into a rank or condition supports delegated position rather than private possession.
Authority and office supply the public jurisdiction from which the course proceeds.
Consultation and managed opinion supply the judgment process that desire can distort.
Entering an undertaking makes the course an enacted responsibility.
Obedient following identifies which authority governs the undertaking.
Mutually reinforced contentious inclination turns plural desires into rival programs of judgment.
Disclosure to a knower sets the epistemic qualification missing from rival counsel.

changed_reading.before: The instruction is chiefly about personal fidelity.
changed_reading.after: The instruction also protects delegated judgment from capture by mutually reinforcing, epistemically unqualified factions.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sharia object, the demand to follow, the prohibition using the same following root, and the contrast with unknowing desires.
baseline_models.mechanism: The course can be heard as sufficient to reach its end, while every chosen following carries a consequence that adheres to the follower. Its adequacy contrasts with hollow desire and makes conduct, not rule accumulation, decisive.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency that reaches an objective makes the course adequate rather than merely extensive.
Binding demand converts adequacy into an obligation to enact the course.
An adhering liability makes each act of following carry its own claim or consequence.
Fit and coherence make faithful following an integrated practice rather than a loose inventory.
Emptiness and lack of inner stability provide the negative image of an inadequate guide.

changed_reading.before: Sharia is an external inventory whose value lies in comprehensiveness.
changed_reading.after: Sharia is an adequate, coherent practice that reaches its end, and whichever line one follows brings an attached consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening descent, book, and wisdom sequence turns the focus placement into reception of a delivered, binding, corrective course. The route image remains live, but it now carries textual and restraining force.

activation_trace.role: A directed opening remains the focus course whose authority the context sharpens.
Demand and obligation anchor the delivered course in binding address.
Obedient following is the recipient's enacted response to delivery.
Caused descent as conveyance supplies the source-to-recipient delivery of the course.
A fixed record that obligates or determines supplies binding persistence to what is delivered.
Restraint that turns back disorder for repair makes the course corrective rather than merely informative.

structural_cues: 45:2 places descent, book, might, and wisdom before the sequence of signs and responses.
45:6 later presents continuing recitation upon an addressee, preserving an ongoing reception structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, binding record, corrective restraint, and the focus placement; I infer that delivery authorizes the course. A live alternative is that these establish only the wider discourse while sharia remains primarily a traversable route.

changed_reading.before: The course is available and authoritative, but its mode of arrival is unspecified.
changed_reading.after: The course is a delivered and durable address whose authority includes restraint and repair.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rain is delivered, dead earth is revived, winds are turned, and a vessel flows through the sea by the affair. These sequences literalize the focus water-access branch and recast sharia as a channel that makes life and purposeful motion possible.

activation_trace.role: The accessible water-entry branch supplies the focus model's channel and destination.
Following supplies responsive movement through the channel.
Delivered descent supplies water to the lower field rather than leaving provision remote.
Earth coming alive through water supplies the channel's life-bearing effect.
Turning from state to state supplies controlled redirection rather than random drift.
Flowing and coursing supply the motion enabled by a prepared medium.
A vessel circulating through water supplies the traveler carried by the ordered channel.
The affair as governing condition explicitly joins enabled flow to the focus course's source.

structural_cues: 45:5 orders descent, revival, and wind-turning as a causal material sequence.
45:12 places sea, vessel, flow, and the affair in one enabling construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies water delivery, revival, controlled turning, and vessel-flow by the affair; I infer that the focus course channels rather than merely commands life-bearing motion. The live alternative is a looser ecological analogy with no causal claim about sharia itself.

changed_reading.before: The watercourse branch is a lexical backdrop for an accessible legal path.
changed_reading.after: The course behaves like an ordered current: it brings access to life, carries purposeful action, and must be entered and followed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence distinguishes exposure from responsive knowledge: one hears yet persists, knows something yet mocks, communities diverge after knowledge through rivalry, and desire can be installed as an object of devotion upon knowledge. The focus denial of knowledge therefore names failed alignment with disclosed marks, not necessarily absence of data.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower anchors the question of what kind of knowing is denied.
A discriminating mark makes knowledge visible as usable orientation.
Inclination supplies the motive that can override disclosed orientation.
Following turns knowledge into practiced alignment and exposes refusal when conduct points elsewhere.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the response that persistence pointedly withholds.
Firm persistence supplies an active resistance after exposure.
Actual acquisition of some knowledge blocks a simple no-information explanation.
Taking mutually different roads supplies communal divergence despite disclosure.
Transgressive rivalry supplies the motive that converts knowledge into faction.
Disclosed knowledge temporally precedes the rivalry and therefore cannot be reduced to ignorance of facts.
Inclination elevated into devotion shows desire reorganizing allegiance rather than merely tempting it.
A secured blocking seal supplies the endpoint of repeatedly refused orientation.

structural_cues: 45:8 moves from hearing to persistence as though no hearing occurred, and 45:9 then grants partial knowing before mockery.
45:17 explicitly orders knowledge before rivalry-driven divergence; 45:23 juxtaposes desire and knowledge in one subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, persistence, knowledge-before-rivalry, desire, and sealing; I infer the arrow from repeated refusal to practical unknowing. Limited comprehension remains a live alternative, so the model does not make every instance of ignorance fully deliberate.

changed_reading.before: Those prohibited as leaders simply lack relevant information.
changed_reading.after: They lack knowledge as governing orientation: signs may have reached them, but persistence, rivalry, and desire prevent those signs from directing practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recompense, acquisition, deliberate action, the self, and return activate the focus branch of adhering consequence. Following the course is not group identification alone; it is practice whose benefit or harm returns to the practitioner.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an undertaking makes the course a practiced commitment.
An adhering claim or liability supplies the consequence carried by either following choice.
Obligation makes the consequential practice answerable rather than optional.
Action met by corresponding return supplies the mechanism of consequence.
Seeking and acquiring a result makes consequence something accumulated through conduct.
Purposive action supplies the concrete unit by which a followed course is enacted.
The self as the very entity concerned identifies the bearer of benefit and harm.
Return to a prior source closes the consequence loop around the actor.

structural_cues: 45:14 links communal action to recompense, and 45:15 assigns good and bad action back to the same self before return.
The focus repeats the same following verb on both sides of the prohibition, allowing both choices to carry consequences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquired action, self-directed benefit or harm, return, and the focus consequence branch; I infer that following generates the adhering consequence. The alternative is a later judgment relation that does not define sharia's immediate operation.

changed_reading.before: Following marks allegiance to the correct norm.
changed_reading.after: Following enacts a course whose consequences adhere to and return upon the follower, whichever leader is chosen.

context_deltas.mechanism: A prior community receives book and judgment, then divides into different roads after clear knowledge through rivalry. The focus 'then' placement reads as a successor commission: preserve and enact a common course from the same affair without reproducing factional capture.

activation_trace.role: Installation into a position supplies the successor commission.
Entry into an undertaking makes succession an enacted custodial task.
Continuous succession gives the new commission temporal continuity with what precedes it.
Mutual contentious inclination supplies the factional pressure the commission must resist.
A binding written determination supplies the inherited institutional charge.
Judgment between people supplies the public dimension of the prior charge.
The same affair-as-concern directly links the prior disclosures to the focus course's source.
Disclosure by statement or mark supplies clarity before the fracture.
Different parties taking different roads supplies the institutional fracture.
Transgressive rivalry supplies the social cause of fracture.
Decisive judgment supplies the unresolved endpoint beyond present factional claims.

structural_cues: 45:16-17 immediately precede the focus and move from inherited institutions to rivalry-driven division.
The focus opens with a temporal successor marker and shifts from a plural community to a singular commissioned addressee.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior institutions, fracture after clarity, rivalry, and then a singular placement; I infer a remedial successor commission. The live alternative is simple contrast with the prior community rather than institutional continuity.

changed_reading.before: The focus begins an independent instruction to follow a revealed law.
changed_reading.after: The focus commissions a successor to carry a shared affair forward without repeating the factional divergence that followed earlier knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The people whose desires are not to be followed appear as mutually supporting parts of an alliance, contrasted with divine guardianship of the protected. Following desire can therefore reroute jurisdiction, intimacy, and protection into a social patronage network.

activation_trace.role: Office and authority make the object of following a question of jurisdiction.
Following an exemplar supplies the transfer of practical allegiance.
Reciprocal contentious desire supplies the affect binding the rival network.
Parts partitioned from a whole supply the network's many mutually referring members.
Proximity without an intervening gap supplies the network's binding closeness.
Affection, support, and alliance supply the network's protective exchange.
Repelling harm through protection supplies the contrasting guardianship outside that network.

structural_cues: 45:19 immediately resumes the focus group with a statement that they cannot avail the addressee.
The verse balances mutual human alliance against a different singular guardianship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural desires, mutual alliance, authority, and contrasting protection; I infer that following transfers social and jurisdictional alignment. A live alternative keeps the alliance statement eschatological and separate from the focus prohibition.

changed_reading.before: The danger is adopting other people's private preferences.
changed_reading.after: The danger is entering a mutually reinforcing patronage order whose desires, authority, and promised protection compete with the commissioned course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus course's equality branch is checked by the later rejection of making unlike practitioners simply equal. The course instead aligns acquired action, judgment, and outcome, preventing the injustice of putting unlike cases in the same place.

activation_trace.role: Equality and matching supply a live but contextually constrained dimension of the course.
Putting persons into a condition supplies the act whose fairness depends on proper differentiation.
Acquiring deeds through one's own agency supplies the differentiating input.
Equating two things supplies the flat sameness the rhetorical question rejects.
Judgment between people identifies the evaluative act condemned when it erases relevant difference.
Corresponding recompense supplies proportional matching in place of flat sameness.
Acquired result supplies the conduct to which the outcome is matched.
Putting something in the wrong place supplies the injustice avoided by calibrated judgment.

structural_cues: 45:21 frames indiscriminate equality as a bad judgment through a rhetorical question.
45:22 immediately replaces sameness with correspondence between each self and what it acquired.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus equality branch, rejection of flat sameness, and action-corresponding recompense; I infer that sharia's equality is calibrated fit. The live alternative is that the focus equality branch is simply inactive here.

changed_reading.before: The course can be generalized as making people equal under one norm.
changed_reading.after: The course establishes equal measure without erasing morally relevant difference: judgment must fit outcomes to acquired action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Each way-bearing community is called to a register, and practiced acts are copied into a record that becomes a speaking sign. This activates following as trace-by-trace movement and attached liability: a followed course leaves an auditable path.

activation_trace.role: Following one trace after another supplies the sequence that can later be reconstructed.
An adhering liability makes the reconstructed trace answerable to its traveler.
A distinguishing mark makes each action legible as evidence of direction.
A gathered people or type supplies the collective bearer of a followed history.
A communal way supplies the path-shaped identity whose conduct is examined.
A vocal summons that draws its object supplies the call from lived path to account.
Enrollment in a register supplies the community-specific audit record.
Evidence that speaks by indication turns the accumulated trace into testimony.
Copying one written form into another supplies faithful preservation of the action sequence.
Purposive deeds supply the entries from which the path is reconstructed.

structural_cues: 45:28 moves from each community to its own book and recompense for what it practiced.
45:29 personifies the record as speaking and explains its relation to continuously copied action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies communal ways, a call to records, copied actions, and evidentiary speech; I infer that following itself leaves the recordable trace. The live alternative is that the judgment record only evaluates actions without illuminating the semantics of following.

changed_reading.before: Following is obedience visible mainly at the moment of choice.
changed_reading.after: Following is cumulative path-making: successive acts leave marks that can be preserved, voiced, and attached to their traveler.

context_deltas.mechanism: Bad acts eventually appear and surround their agents, while worldly life deceives through an attractive but unstable signal. Desire is therefore not merely appetite; it operates as counterfeit guidance that invites adoption and hides the path's attached end until it becomes visible.

activation_trace.role: Inclination supplies the appetite that the counterfeit signs recruit.
A reliable distinguishing mark supplies the standard against which false signals fail.
Following makes successful deception consequential by converting appearance into a traveled line.
Emergence into visibility supplies the delayed disclosure of what the adopted path produced.
Descending harm that encloses its target supplies the path's previously hidden terminal environment.
Taking on a manner or pattern supplies the adoption induced by deceptive guidance.
An overt sign supplies the genuine signal that mockery displaces.
Deception by what flashes yet does not endure supplies the counterfeit signal's attraction.
Uncertainty and danger in the outcome supply what the attractive signal conceals.

structural_cues: 45:33 delays the appearance of consequences until they enclose those who mocked them.
The branchless ع ت ب occurrence at 45:35 word 16 is used only as the terminal structural cue that restoration is no longer available.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reliable signs, attractive deception, adoption, delayed appearance, and enclosure; I infer that desire can function as a rival signaling system. A live alternative treats deception as a general cause of rejection without making it part of the focus navigation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Desire competes with knowledge because appetite overpowers known guidance.
changed_reading.after: Desire can counterfeit knowledge's waymarks, making an unstable and dangerous line look followable until its concealed consequences appear.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins two material, form-distant branches into an armed spatial image. It remains anchored in the focus roots for course, affair, placement, and following; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for decisive orientation, not as the lexical identity of sharia or amr.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The addressee is placed upon a directed sharia from the affair and commanded to maintain one following line against another.

activation_trace.role: Installation into a position supplies the stance from which a direction is maintained.
Projection of a weapon or opening toward a destination supplies the aimed line.
Fitting a shaft with a point supplies the line's sharpened decisiveness.
Going behind a leader supplies disciplined maintenance of the aimed line.
A hand or object cast in a competing direction supplies the deflecting counter-gesture.

changed_reading.before: The course is a norm one follows.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the course is an aimed and sharpened line whose direction must be held against deflecting gestures.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because time-related side branches of affair and desire recast a mostly spatial model as temporal. It remains anchored in the focus's opening succession marker, repeated following, and branch inventories, while 45:24-26 supply the larger horizon; downstream prose should call it a temporal activation rather than a primary lexical reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus begins with temporal succession, commands continuous following, and contrasts the course with plural desires.

activation_trace.role: A sign joined to an appointed time supplies temporal stations within the affair.
Continuous succession supplies passage through stations rather than a momentary choice.
A bounded stretch of night or time supplies the truncated interval mistaken for the whole horizon.
Extended time supplies the rival account that confines reality to worldly duration.
A defined duration supplies the destination beyond the immediately visible interval.
Gathering separated parts supplies the itinerary's terminal convergence.

changed_reading.before: The course directs conduct within the present.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the course is a temporal itinerary toward gathering, while desire mistakes one passing interval for the whole journey.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping of د ر ي to root_000469 and its road-bearing and whirlpool branches. It remains valid as a latent activation because the focus already binds directed course, following, rapid desire, and knowledge-as-waymark; downstream prose must identify it as a cross-mapped navigation image, not an etymological claim about د ر ي.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus opposes a directed course and marked knowledge to fast-moving desires followed by those who do not know.

activation_trace.role: A directed opening supplies the stable bearing.
Following supplies movement whose outcome depends on the available bearing.
A distinguishing waymark supplies navigational knowledge.
Rapid rushing supplies movement that can outrun orientation.
The bearing of a road or wind supplies the missing directional knowledge in the denial.
A rotating water eddy supplies the alternative motion of uncertainty without forward bearing.
Stable knowledge free of doubt supplies the contrast to eddying uncertainty.

changed_reading.before: Not knowing means uncertainty about a proposition.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, not knowing is loss of bearing: without the marked course, rapid motion circles like an eddy instead of advancing.

strongest_changes: Sharia shifted from a static legal object to an accessible, delivered course that channels life-bearing and purposeful motion.
The closing denial of knowledge shifted from informational deficit to failed practical orientation after exposure, often driven by rivalry and desire.
Following became cumulative and accountable: it transfers allegiance, returns consequences to the actor, and leaves a recordable trace.
The immediate succession from prior communal fracture made the singular placement read as an anti-factional commission.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots supported unusually coherent movement across hydraulic, navigational, institutional, social, and audit domains without forcing them into one final reading. The repeated positive and negative following verb kept every activation anchored as a choice of line, while split-root context material preserved stranger bearings such as the compass-and-whirlpool outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: The water-access and current model may be a strong material analogy rather than a governing sense of sharia in this construction.
Practical unknowing is strongly activated, but the text need not make every member of the prohibited group equally informed or deliberate.
The successor-commission reading depends on treating immediate temporal sequence as institutional continuity rather than contrast alone.
The sharpened-line, temporal-itinerary, and non-dominant د ر ي activations should remain explicitly exploratory.
